description: For an infinite cardinal lambda and a cardinal kappa between two and two to the lambda, kappa to the lambda equals two to the lambda.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ContinuumFunction.large_exponents.{u} (κ τ : Cardinal.{u}) (hτ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ τ) (hκ : 2 ≤ κ)
  (hupper : κ ≤ 2 ^ τ) : κ ^ τ = 2 ^ τ
